item.description:

item.title: ESA’s Juice spacecraft uses Earth gravity for Jupiter mission
item.description:
The Juice spacecraft completed an Earth flyby on September 28, using planetary gravity to adjust its trajectory toward Jupiter. This maneuver increased the spacecraft's speed and provided a unique opportunity to test scientific instruments.

item.description:
